title: Choose the Helios Control world
question: The architecture is fixed: one operator shell, one navigation plane, live-to-historical time, embedded inspection, and contextual execution. Choose the visual system that should make it feel inevitable.

options.label: Seismic Array Logbook
options.lineage: seismic network control rooms and rolling event records
options.thesis: Continuous traces stay quiet until a causal rupture earns intervention.
options.viewport: A single left rail frames one synchronized field: source traces, hypothesis ruptures, signal admission, orders, and position impact share the same horizontal time axis while the exception ledger stays visible at right.
options.risk: It becomes science cosplay if seismic notation ever replaces explicit trading language.

raised.raise: Every intervention carries a literal action, owner, and authority tag.
Duration, latency, and overlap are expressed spatially instead of narrated.
The causal pipeline remains one continuous inspectable object across routes.

options.label: Flight Dynamics Desk
options.lineage: flight-director consoles, station loops, and mission logs
options.thesis: The desk is organized around decisions, stations, and verified handoffs rather than dashboards.
options.viewport: A calm station rail opens onto a broad operational plot, with feeds and signals at left, portfolio and risk at center, and the live order handoff at the edge of the same field.
options.risk: It is the most familiar direction and can collapse into generic sci-fi mission control if the craft is timid.

options.label: Evidence Exposure Record
options.lineage: darkroom exposure sheets and eleven-zone print records
options.thesis: Every decision is a layered exposure record whose conflicts become visible before capital moves.
options.viewport: Backlit sheets for source, hypothesis, risk, and execution overlap over one time record; sliding a sheet exposes evidence without replacing the operational field beneath it.
options.case: Excellent product clarity for causal evidence and conflicts; slightly less native to a trader's operating environment than the assigned direction.
options.risk: Layering can become decorative paperwork unless every overlap corresponds to a real dependency.

options.label: Signal Sequencer
options.lineage: early-80s rhythm machines and clocked step rows
options.thesis: A strategy is a timed sequence whose live state advances across one unmistakable chase line.
options.viewport: The causal pipeline spans the viewport as one clocked strip; feeds, signals, risk gates, and executions occupy aligned steps while detailed ledgers sit beneath it.
options.case: Exceptional live and historical time comprehension; weaker when the workflow is dominated by irregular exceptions, allocations, and multi-day orders.
options.risk: It can feel playful or imply fixed cadence where the real system is event-driven.

options.label: Literal Stockroom
options.lineage: industrial garment tags and warehouse labeling
options.thesis: Commands and states wear literal labels and visible ownership tags.
options.viewport: A brutally literal command inventory with diagonal exception boundaries.
options.case: Strong naming discipline, but weak audience identification and poor support for continuous telemetry.
options.kept: Literal action, owner, and authority tags were raised into the assigned direction.
options.risk: The fashion grammar overwhelms the operational subject.

options.label: Causal Score
options.thesis: Length is duration, alignment is simultaneity, and shape is action.
options.viewport: A vertical bilateral score of strategy actions and responses.
options.case: Precise for time and overlap, but its bottom-to-top reading direction fights the operator's expected timeline and ledger patterns.
options.kept: Spatial duration and overlap were raised into the assigned direction.
options.risk: The notation requires learning before it helps.

options.label: System Cutaway
options.thesis: The whole trading system stays visible while individual walls swing open for inspection.
options.viewport: A continuous causal landscape from feed to filled position.
options.case: The pipeline concept is clear, but the visual character is too playful for capital authority and dense OMS work.
options.kept: The continuous inspectable pipeline was raised into the assigned direction.
options.risk: Operational seriousness collapses under the illustrative world.

canonCard.label: Institutional Dark Blotter
canonCard.thesis: The category-standard enterprise OMS, executed with exceptional restraint and clarity.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional collapsible sidebar, portfolio summary, working-order blotter, source health, and alert center.
canonCard.risk: Reliable and immediately legible, but deliberately indistinguishable from polished institutional competitors.
